prompt_text: Who is the best moving company in Pleasanton CA for a local move?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on the size of your move, timing and budget. A quick plan you can use right now:

1. Quick questions for me so I can give a tailored shortlist:
   - ZIP code in Pleasanton (or pickup/delivery addresses)
   - Size of the move (studio/1/2/3+ bedrooms, lots of heavy items)
   - Move date or window
   - Do you need packing, piano/specialty item moves, storage?
   - Approximate budget or whether you prefer lowest price vs highest service level

2. How to find the best local mover (what to check)
   - Get at least 3 on-site or video estimates (not just phone quotes).
   - Make sure the company is licensed and insured for moves in California.
   - Read recent Google/Yelp reviews for similar-size local moves (not just one-offs).
   - Ask about binding vs non-binding estimates, hourly vs flat-rate pricing, and all potential extra fees (stairs, long carries, shuttle trucks, parking permits).
   - Confirm insurance/liability options (released value vs full replacement) and whether they offer coverage or if you need third-party insurance.
   - Ask about crew experience, whether they provide furniture pads/blankets, disassembly/reassembly, and estimated arrival window.
   - Get everything in writing (estimate, pickup/delivery windows, cancellation terms).

3. Red flags
   - Very low estimate that changes dramatically on moving day.
   - No local address or only a mobile phone number.
   - Pushy sales tactics to sign immediately.
   - Poor or no proof of insurance or licensing.

If you want, give me your ZIP code, move size and date and I’ll shortlist 4–5 highly rated local movers (with notes on pros/cons and what to ask each) so you can contact them for quotes. Which details can you share?
